zh: （拍摄超速车辆的）超速监控摄像机
en: a machine which takes pictures of vehicles that are being driven faster than the legal limit. The pictures are then used as evidence so that the drivers can be punished.

zh: 快速相亲，闪电约会（为单身者安排的约会方式，每人只限与一人交谈几分钟即转往下一人）
en: meeting people at an event organized for single people who want to begin a romantic relationship, where you are allowed to spend only a few minutes talking to one person before you have to move on to meet the next person

zh: a feature on a phone that allows numbers to be stored so that they can be called by pressing a single key
en: a feature on a phone that allows numbers to be stored so that they can be called by pressing a single key
ex: He's my best friend—I have him on speed dial.
他是我最好的朋友，我让他快速拨号。

en: a raised area across a road that is put there to make traffic go slower
